recall_prompt: Say how you would find the mean deviation about the median for eight numbers — what you do to the data first, how you pick the median when n is even, and what you average at the end.
insider_note: n = 8 is even, so the median is the average of the 4th and 5th sorted values, (10 + 12)/2 = 11; the deviations are taken from 11 — not from the mean 10 that the same data gives.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Median
steps.margin_note: First mark. Sort first. n = 8 is even, so there are two middle values, the 4th and 5th (10 and 12); the median is their average, 11.
steps.memory_tip: Even n: average the 4th and 5th sorted values, (10 + 12)/2 = 11. The median need not be in the data.
lines: n = 8 is even, so M = (4th value + 5th value)/2.

recall.must_convey: That the values are sorted, n = 8 is even, and the median is the average of the two middle values, (10 + 12)/2 = 11.
accept: put the numbers in order, eight is even so take the fourth and fifth values ten and twelve, their average eleven is the median
sort the data, the two middle values are ten and twelve, median eleven
with an even count the median is the average of the two middle numbers, eleven
ascending order lo pettite madhyalo ten and twelve unnayi, average eleven, adi median

steps.why: With an even number of values there is no single middle item, so the median is defined as the average of the two middle items. That is why 11, a value not in the data, is the median.
common_mistakes: Taking 10 or 12 alone as the median.
Reading the middle of the unsorted list.
Using the mean (80/8 = 10) instead of the median.

steps.label: Mean deviation
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Absolute deviations from 11, in the sorted order: 7, 5, 4, 1, 1, 1, 2, 5. Sum 26, divide by n = 8. 26/8 = 3.25.
steps.memory_tip: The mean of this same data is 10 — subtract the median 11 instead. 26/8 = 3.25.

recall.must_convey: That the absolute deviations from 11 are 7, 5, 4, 1, 1, 1, 2, 5, their sum 26 divided by 8 gives 3.25.
accept: take each number minus eleven without sign, add to twenty six, divide by eight, three point two five
the absolute deviations from the median add to twenty six and twenty six by eight is three point two five
mean deviation is sigma mod x i minus M by n equals twenty six by eight equals three point two five
eleven nunchi deviations mod teesukoni add cheste twenty six, eight tho divide cheste three point two five
the answer is three point two five

steps.why: Mean deviation about the median is the average distance from the median. It is never larger than the mean deviation about the mean: the median minimises the total distance. Here n is even, so every value from 10 to 12 gives the same smallest total 26 — and the mean of this data is exactly 10, one of those two middle values, which is why both measures come to 3.25.
common_mistakes: Subtracting from the mean 10 instead of from the median 11.
Dropping one of the three 1's when adding.
